h: לַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר בְּאָב, ג׳ Tu B'Av, 3

p: לְהָבִין עִנְיַן הַיּוֹם טוֹב שֶׁל ט״ו בְּאָב
To understand the matter of the Yom Tov of the fifteenth of Av,
לַעֲשׂוֹת בּוֹ סְעוּדָה שֶׁל מִשְׁתֶּה וְשִׂמְחָה,
of making on it a meal of feasting and rejoicing —
for what reason is it a seudas mitzvah?
Now even if, according to the Pesikta
the building of the future Beis HaMikdash
will be in the sign of the lion, which is Av,
and we said (in the previous maamar)
that the fifteenth of Av is meant —
מִכׇּל מָקוֹם אֵין בָּזֶה טַעַם מַסְפִּיק
still, this is not a sufficient reason
to make it a Yom Tov now
on account of what will take place on it,
the building of the Beis HaMikdash in the future.
For all the festivals and Yamim Tovim
that were given for rejoicing and Yom Tov
הוּא עַל שֵׁם הַמְּאוֹרָע בּוֹ בַּיּוֹם מִכְּבָר;
are on account of what already occurred on that day;
and a resting of holiness at that time,
and it is fitting to make on it a Yom Tov
אֲבָל לֹא עַל מַה שֶּׁיִּהְיֶה לֶעָתִיד.
but not on account of what will be in the future.
עַל פִּי הַגְּמָרָא (סוֹף תַּעֲנִית לא, א)
based on the Gemara (end of Taanis, 31a)
one who adds will have added to him";
and Rashi, of blessed memory, explains:
one who adds nights to the days
will have life added to his life.
at the increase of Torah she'b'al peh,
which specifically increased after the Churban,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִזְכֶּה לְאוֹר גָּדוֹל
And through this we will merit the great light
of the building of the Beis HaMikdash,
as is stated in the Tanchuma (Noach 3)
on the pasuk "The people that walk in darkness
עַל פָּסוּק כִּי אָדָם לְעָמָל יוּלָּד (אִיּוֹב ה, ז):
on the pasuk "For man is born to toil" (Iyov 5:7):
he was created for the toil of Torah —
for the entire purpose of man's creation
is to do his work and his service
in the toil of Torah and the service of Hashem Yisbarach.
And at the time of creation,
when it was as it says,
וְהָאֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה אֶת הָאָדָם יָשָׁר (קֹהֶלֶת ז, כט),
what was intended of man was only
which is the aspect of daylight,
and to his labor until evening" (Tehillim 104:22–23).
For the main time of man's work and service
in his Torah is specifically by day,
"And the night was a watch for us,
it became necessary specifically to add to the study of Torah
in the darkness of night as well;
וְהוּא בְּחִינַת הִתְרַבּוּת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
and this is the aspect of the increase of Torah she'b'al peh,
"He has set me in dark places" (Eichah 3:6) —
and on the pasuk "The people that walk in darkness":
these are the masters of Talmud —
which is in order to illuminate
the darkness of the yetzer hara,
which darkens the faces of people.
עַל פָּסוּק כִּי בְּרַב חׇכְמָה רָב כָּעַס
on the pasuk "For in much wisdom is much anger" —
שֶׁדַּיְיקָא עַל יְדֵי רוֹב כַּעַס שֶׁל הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע
that specifically through the much anger of the yetzer hara
which has increased in a person's heart,
שֶׁהוּא עִנְיַן הִתְרַבּוּת חׇכְמַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה.
which is the increase of the wisdom of Torah she'b'al peh.
the wisdom of Torah she'b'al peh increased
And as is stated in Sefer Heichalos (chapter 27):
שִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר לְשׁוֹנוֹת שֶׁל שֶׁבַח הַתּוֹרָה
seventeen expressions of praise of the Torah,
"its radiance and its splendor," and so on,
after the destruction of the First Temple,
in order to illuminate the darkness of the night
And through this specifically we will merit
שֶׁל בִּנְיַן בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ,
of the building of the Beis HaMikdash, speedily in our days,
עַל פָּסוּק כִּי יִתְנוּ בַגּוֹיִם (הוֹשֵׁעַ ח, י):
on the pasuk "Though they hire among the nations" (Hoshea 8:10):
in the merit of the Mishnayos they will be redeemed —
and as is stated in the Tanchuma (Noach 3)
on the pasuk "The people that walk in darkness
these are the masters of Talmud,
whose eyes HaKadosh Baruch Hu is destined
to illuminate in the time to come.
וְזֶהוּ שֶׁרָמְזוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּט״ו בְּאָב:
This is what Chazal alluded to regarding the fifteenth of Av:
"One who adds will have added to him" —
that eternal life will be added to him,
the building of the Beis HaMikdash, speedily in our days,
which will be on this day,
Consequently there is also a basis
for feasting and rejoicing on this day,
which is called "the day of the gladness of His heart";
כִּי אֵין שִׂמְחָה אֶלָּא בְּיַיִן (פְּסָחִים קט, א),
for there is no rejoicing except with wine (Pesachim 109a),
וְיַיִן יְשַׂמַּח לְבַב אֱנוֹשׁ (תְּהִלִּים קד, טו).
"And wine gladdens the heart of man" (Tehillim 104:15).
This is the matter of the joy
of the increase of Torah she'b'al peh in the heart,
פִּקּוּדֵי ה׳ יְשָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי לֵב (תְּהִלִּים יט, ט),
"The precepts of Hashem are upright, gladdening the heart" (Tehillim 19:9),
הַמְרַמֵּז עַל בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה;
which alludes to the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh;
for they straighten the crookedness in the heart
and from this joy is born in the heart.
שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת אוֹר שֶׁל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
which is the aspect of the light of Torah she'b'al peh
that is sown in the heart of a tzaddik;
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה וּלְיִשְׁרֵי לֵב שִׂמְחָה,
and through this, "and for the upright of heart, joy" —
for it straightens the crookedness in the heart,
and from this joy is born.
וְהִנֵּה אִיתָא בַּגְּמָרָא (תַּעֲנִית ל, ב – לא, א)
שִׁשָּׁה טְעָמִים עַל יוֹם טוֹב שֶׁל ט״ו בְּאָב;
six reasons for the Yom Tov of the fifteenth of Av;
for which it should be established permanently
as a Yom Tov like the other Yamim Tovim,
where, from the illumination of the original miracle
that came to Klal Yisrael at that time,
an illumination of that holiness flows
in the present as well to Klal Yisrael,
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן בַּטְּעָמִים שֶׁל ט״ו בְּאָב
This is not so with the reasons for the fifteenth of Av
which concerned only a particular matter
such as the reason that the tribes were permitted
and that the tribe of Binyamin was permitted to enter the congregation,
and so with all of them.
If so, what is its relevance,
that on this account it should be a Yom Tov
אָמְנָם עַל פִּי דְּבָרֵנוּ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
However, according to what we said above,
it will be understood that on this day
there sparkles forth the rectification of the blemishes
מַה שֶּׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה נֶחֱרַב הַבַּיִת;
through which the House was destroyed;
and through the rectification of the blemishes
we will merit the building of the Beis HaMikdash —
may it be rebuilt speedily in our days —
שֶׁעִיקַּר רוֹב כַּעַס שֶׁל הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע
that the main "much anger" of the yetzer hara
שֶׁמּוֹצִיאִין אֶת הָאָדָם מִן הָעוֹלָם (אָבוֹת ד, כא).
which drive a person from the world (Avos 4:21).
when the good is brought out
וְיֵשׁ לִרְמֹז זֶה גַּם כֵּן בַּגְּמָרָא
This too can be found alluded to in the Gemara
because of a rooster and a hen
because of the shaft of a carriage
which correspond to the three blemishes
וְנֶגֶד זֶה רָמְזוּ גַּם כֵּן בַּגְּמָרָא
And correspondingly the Gemara also alluded to
עַל יוֹם טוֹב שֶׁל ט״ו בְּאָב,
for the Yom Tov of the fifteenth of Av,
because on that day there sparkles forth
הַתִּיקּוּן עַל שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַפְּגָמִים הַנִּזְכָּרִים לְעֵיל.
the rectification of the three blemishes mentioned above.
The matter of Kamtza and Bar Kamtza
and baseless hatred that was among them.
And corresponding to this Chazal alluded to
the reason for the fifteenth of Av,
יוֹם שֶׁהוּתְּרוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים לָבוֹא זֶה בָּזֶה,
"the day the tribes were permitted to marry into one another,"
which is the rectification of jealousy.
For even in that generation, when they were forbidden
through the claim of the sons of Yosef
that an inheritance should not pass from tribe to tribe
הָיָה נִרְאֶה עַל הַגָּוֶון כְּעִנְיַן קִנְאָה;
it looked on the surface like a matter of jealousy;
for what did it matter to them
if the inheritances of the tribes became mixed?
was for the sake of Heaven,
out of love for the Land —
and just as there are particular aspects of holiness
in the soul of each tribe on its own,
such as Reuven in the holiness of sight
and Shimon in the holiness of hearing,
there are particular aspects in the months of the year;
in the holiness of Eretz Yisrael,
there is a division of the aspects of the borders
according to the aspects of the tribes,
כְּאָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא קכב, א)
that the lot would call out:
the boundary of such-and-such region comes up with it.
כִּי כׇּל גְּבוּל יֵשׁ לוֹ שַׁיָּיכוּת
For each border has a connection,
in the aspect of its holiness,
And even if it sometimes happens
that the holiness of one tribe's border passes
it is still not in perpetuity
"And you shall return, each man to his holding,
and each man to his family" (Vayikra 25:10).
And this was the claim of the sons of Yosef:
עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה וְגוֹמֵר (בַּמִּדְבָּר לו, ד).
to the inheritance of the tribe," etc. (Bamidbar 36:4).
לָכֵן הִסְכִּים לָהֶם הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
Therefore HaKadosh Baruch Hu agreed with them
as a ruling for that time,
מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהָיָה פְּנִימִיּוּת כַּוָּנָתָם לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם,
since their inner intent was for the sake of Heaven,
even though it looked like jealousy.
they found on that day an exposition
from the pasuk "This is the thing" (Bamidbar 36:6),
the tribes may intermingle with one another.
וְזֶה הִתְנוֹצְצוּת תִּיקּוּן הַפְּגָם שֶׁל קִנְאָה
This is the sparkling forth of the rectification of the blemish of jealousy
that took place on this day,
עַל יְדֵי שֶׁהוּתְּרוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים לָבוֹא זֶה בָּזֶה.
through the tribes being permitted to marry into one another.
And "because of a rooster and a hen
this is the aspect of the blemish of desire
וְנֶגֶד זֶה הוּא הַתִּיקּוּן שֶׁל אוֹתוֹ יוֹם
and corresponding to this is the rectification of that day
when the tribe of Binyamin was permitted to enter the congregation.
כַּיָּדוּעַ שֶׁהָיָה עַל יְדֵי פְּגַם הַתַּאֲוָה
For as is known, it was through the blemish of desire
that the entire tribe was blemished by this,
in that they strengthened the hands of the transgressors;
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִשְׁבְּעוּ כְּלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל
and because of this Klal Yisrael swore
שֶׁלֹּא יִתְּנוּ לְבִנְיָמִין אִשָּׁה (שׁוֹפְטִים כא, א),
not to give a wife to Binyamin (Shoftim 21:1),
for in their view the whole tribe was blemished forever.
Afterward they found them a remedy
that they are permitted to enter the congregation,
for it is a tradition that a tribe will not be wiped out;
and this is the rectification of desire.
And "because of the shaft of a carriage Beitar was destroyed" —
הוּא בְּחִינַת פְּגַם שֶׁל כָּבוֹד וְהִתְנַשְּׂאוּת
this is the aspect of the blemish of honor and self-exaltation
לָכֵן הָיוּ נוֹטְעִים אֲרָזִים (גִּיטִּין נז, א)
that is why they would plant cedars (Gittin 57a),
עַל שֵׁם כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה (תְּהִלִּים צב, יג).
on account of "like a cedar in Levanon he shall grow tall" (Tehillim 92:13).
came about because there was among them
an abundance of words of Torah;
וַעֲבוּר זֶה הָיָה סָבוּר רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא
and on account of this Rabbi Akiva thought
of Ben Koziva that he was Mashiach.
And it says in the Rambam, of blessed memory
that Rabbi Akiva was the arms-bearer
כִּי רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא הָיָה שׁוֹרֶשׁ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
for Rabbi Akiva was the root of Torah she'b'al peh,
all the anonymous teachings follow Rabbi Akiva;
and it also says in the Tanchuma (Chukas 8)
עַל פָּסוּק וְכׇל יְקָר רָאֲתָה עֵינוֹ (אִיּוֹב כח, י):
on the pasuk "And his eye saw every precious thing" (Iyov 28:10):
this is Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues —
things that were not revealed to Moshe
were revealed to Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues.
And because there was in Beitar,
in the generation of Rabbi Akiva,
an increase of the wisdom of Torah she'b'al peh,
he thought that in their merit Mashiach would come,
כְּאָמְרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה ז, ג)
עַל פָּסוּק כִּי יִתְנוּ בַגּוֹיִם וְגוֹמֵר
on the pasuk "Though they hire among the nations," etc.,
that in the merit of the Mishnayos —
שֶׁהָיָה אָז עִיקַּר תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
which were then the essence of Torah she'b'al peh —
וְגַם אָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (קֹהֶלֶת רַבָּה יא, ח):
הֶבֶל הוּא נֶגֶד תּוֹרָתוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ.
is vanity compared to the Torah of Mashiach.
גָּדַע בׇּחֳרִי אַף כֹּל קֶרֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל (אֵיכָה ב, ג).
"He cut off in fierce anger every horn of Yisrael" (Eichah 2:3).
הוּא הַהִתְנַשְּׂאוּת שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם עַל יְדֵי הַתּוֹרָה,
is the exaltation they have through the Torah,
"His horn shall be exalted in honor" (Tehillim 112:9);
וְעַל יְדֵי הַפְּגָם שֶׁל הִתְנַשְּׂאוּת שֶׁלָּהֶם
And through their blemish of self-exaltation
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (תַּעֲנִית ז, א):
"Just as water leaves a high place
and goes to a low place,
only in one whose mind is humble."
Therefore they were punished measure for measure,
in that they were not given over for burial,
And on the fifteenth of Av, when they were given over for burial,
כִּי אֵין טוֹב אֶלָּא תּוֹרָה (בְּרָכוֹת ה, א),
כִּי לֶקַח טוֹב וְגוֹמֵר (מִשְׁלֵי ד, ב);
"For I have given you good teaching," etc. (Mishlei 4:2);
is the bestowal of Torah upon those who receive it;
וְזֶה הָיָה עִיקַּר תִּיקּוּנָם כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
and this was their chief rectification, as mentioned above
(and it was explained at length above, section 1).
Now these three blemishes mentioned above,
הֵם הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ שֶׁל הַשָּׁלֹשׁ עֲבֵירוֹת הַחֲמוּרוֹת:
are the root of the three severe sins:
עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה גִּלּוּי עֲרָיוֹת וּשְׁפִיכוּת דָּמִים.
one comes to murder and bloodshed;
For through the self-exaltation in a person
he wishes to rule over everything,
and after that to make himself a god,
"I will ascend above the heights of the clouds;
I will be like the Most High" (Yeshayah 14:14);
it is as if he worships idols.
There are two more reasons in the Gemara
the day on which the dying in the wilderness came to an end,
וְיוֹם שֶׁבִּיטֵּל בּוֹ הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן אֵלָה
and the day on which Hoshea ben Elah abolished
set up so that they should not go up for the festival.
And these two are a rectification
עַל פְּגַם עָוֹן הֶחָמוּר שֶׁל לָשׁוֹן הָרָע,
of the blemish of the severe sin of lashon hara,
שָׁלֹשׁ עֲבֵירוֹת הַנִּזְכָּרוֹת לְעֵיל (עֲרָכִין טו, ב),
and the Churban chiefly stemmed from it.
For the dying in the wilderness was decreed
עַל יְדֵי עָוֹן לָשׁוֹן הָרָע שֶׁל מְרַגְּלִים,
through the sin of lashon hara of the Meraglim,
who established weeping for the generations
over the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash
and it was decreed then to scatter them among the lands.
וּבַיּוֹם שֶׁכָּלוּ מֵתֵי מִדְבָּר בְּט״ו בְּאָב
And on the day the dying in the wilderness ended, on the fifteenth of Av,
a rectification was made for the lashon hara
that established weeping for the generations.
through which the kingdom of the House of David was divided,

The last reason in the Gemara (Taanis 31a):
that on that day they stopped

For the bringing of wood to the Mizbeach
when the nations had laid waste the trees of Eretz Yisrael,
וְלֹא הָיָה מָצוּי מַה לְּבַעֵר עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ,
and there was nothing available to burn on the Mizbeach;
so they instituted the donating of wood
לְהַלְהִיב אֶת אֵשׁ הַקְּדוּשָּׁה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ.
to kindle the fire of holiness on the Mizbeach.
And on the fifteenth of Av
that flows down on that day suffices
who are worthy and have the Shechinah between them (Sotah 17a);
and through this there come to be
two times "fire" of the One Above,
לְכַלּוֹת הָאֵשׁ שֶׁל הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע שֶׁל תַּאֲוָה
to consume the fire of the yetzer hara of desire,
and the fire of the yetzer hara
"There came forth something like a fiery lion cub
וְאָמַר עוֹד שָׁם בַּגְּמָרָא (תַּעֲנִית לא, א):
It says further there in the Gemara (Taanis 31a):
"And they call it the day of the breaking of the axe";
שֶׁעַל יְדֵי חֶרֶב הַגְּבוּרָה שֶׁל הַקְּדוּשָּׁה,
that through the sword of might of holiness,
of which it is said regarding Gavriel,
"with his sword drawn in his hand" (Yehoshua 5:13),
אָמַר לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְגַבְרִיאֵל
HaKadosh Baruch Hu said to Gavriel,
through this the axe is broken:
the sword of might of the opposing side,
הוּא הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע שֶׁל הַקִּנְאָה וּרְצִיחָה,
which is the yetzer hara of jealousy and murder,
"And by your sword you shall live" (Bereishis 27:40);
וְכׇל הַשָּׁלֹשׁ אִשּׁוֹת הֵם רַק בִּקְדוּשָּׁה:
and all three fires are then only in holiness.
